name: Elliott
description: Rents a cabin on the beach and writes dramatic prose. Loves crab cakes, pomegranates, and a good metaphor.

seo.title: Elliott — Writer
seo.description: Rents a cabin on the beach and writes dramatic prose. Loves crab cakes, pomegranates, and a good metaphor.

stardew.intro: The beach cabin poet of Pelican Town. Flamboyant, romantic, and always one draft away from finishing his novel.

heartEvents.title: Beach reading
heartEvents.summary: Visit his cabin while he reads — he asks what you think of his latest passage.

heartEvents.title: Piano at the saloon
heartEvents.summary: Find him playing piano at the Stardrop Saloon on a rainy afternoon.

heartEvents.title: Rowboat confession
heartEvents.summary: He takes you rowing and reads a love poem he wrote about someone mysterious.

heartEvents.title: Galaxy sword
heartEvents.summary: After you bring a Galaxy Sword, he imagines you as the hero of his next book.

heartEvents.title: Beach kiss
heartEvents.summary: On a warm evening at the pier, he finally stops writing and kisses you.

relationships.name: Willy
relationships.note: Friendly with the fisherman — they share the beach and the saloon.

relationships.name: Leah
relationships.note: Fellow artist soul; they appreciate each other’s creative streak.

trivia: Crab Cakes need crab, egg, flour, and oil — a solid gift once you reach the beach mines.
